first.rationale: Verify the two directly relevant records: shortened onboarding improved completion and time-to-value, while signup simplification improved first-week activation. A guarded onboarding simplification experiment addresses both current declines and is more likely to support sustainable qualified revenue than reacting solely with pricing. Monitor downstream qualified conversion and retention to ensure higher activation is not merely superficial.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding to address both the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline. The verified onboarding record showed a 13% completion lift, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and 3% higher 30-day retention. Do not directly replicate signup-field reduction because its SMB result included a 1% retention decline and did not generalize beyond SMB. Gate success on qualified revenue, retention, and meaningful product adoption—not completion alone.
